posts_checked.text:
Yes, majority of my Dutch friends are "burn out"

You get 1 year of FREE fully paid salary and then another year of 70% FREE fully paid salary and you can just sit at home and chill!

You have to keep "appearances" up though because you might get snitched, so on Facetime with friends you do this schtick:

"It's all too much for me"

"I'm so tired"

"I don't think I can go back to work yet"

Meanwhile it's partyyyyyyyy time chilling at home with Netflix and popcorn

Welcome to European social welfare in 2026 😂

是的，我大多数荷兰朋友都在「burn out」（过劳假）

你能拿一年全薪免费工资，然后再拿一年七成全薪免费工资，就坐在家里躺平！

不过得装样子，因为可能被人打小报告，所以和朋友 Facetime 时要演这套：

「对我来说压力太大了」

「我太累了」

「我觉得还没法回去上班」

与此同时其实是在家看 Netflix 吃爆米花 partyyyyyyyy

欢迎来到 2026 年的欧洲社会福利 😂
